# Federico Schwindt

> From sketch to sold. Federico Schwindt is a whole creative team in one person: web designer, developer, brand strategist and marketer, working through requests with AI-assisted workflows. Every client gets their own dashboard to send requests and follow the work. Based in Argentina (GMT-3), working in English and Spanish with small businesses in the United States, Israel, Australia, India and Argentina. One person handles design, code, branding, marketing and social media.

## Services
- [Web design](https://federico-schwindt.github.io/portfolio-FEDERICOSCH/services/web-design/): custom page design on real content, clickable prototype before code. Quoted before work starts.
- [Web development](https://federico-schwindt.github.io/portfolio-FEDERICOSCH/services/web-development/): custom sites, WordPress, WooCommerce and Shopify, product finders and forms. Quoted before work starts.
- [Branding](https://federico-schwindt.github.io/portfolio-FEDERICOSCH/services/branding/): logo system, colours, type, voice and a brand guide.
- [Marketing](https://federico-schwindt.github.io/portfolio-FEDERICOSCH/services/marketing/): technical and local SEO, Google Ads, Meta Ads, analytics and a monthly report.
- [Community management](https://federico-schwindt.github.io/portfolio-FEDERICOSCH/services/community-management/): monthly content calendar, designed posts and short videos, replies and a report. Monthly, quoted after a short call.
- [Motion & 3D](https://federico-schwindt.github.io/portfolio-FEDERICOSCH/services/motion-3d/): 3D product renders, angle sets and product films.

## Working together
- Every project gets a clear quote after a short call, before work starts.
- [Free website audit](https://federico-schwindt.github.io/portfolio-FEDERICOSCH/audit/): a short, honest review within 48 hours.

## Proof
- [Universal Driveshafts](https://federico-schwindt.github.io/portfolio-FEDERICOSCH/work/universal-driveshafts/): e-commerce redesign and growth, +551% sales from 2024 to 2026, 7,541 parts searchable by vehicle.
- 5.0 average rating across 13 projects on Freelancer.com.
